description: Creates a collection: from blank (a required Title field) or a starter (Blog posts, Projects, Team, Products, Events, Jobs, Testimonials, FAQ, with fields and sample items), plus extra fields and page settings. On a Xodia template or Vite React site it also installs the CMS kit when missing and creates the collection page (src/pages/collections/<Name>Page.tsx on /<urlFolder>/:slug) with its route: never hand-write collection.json, item files or that page's route. Plain HTML sites get the collection only. Writes go to the branch the workspace has open, the same as the Content tab. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. Works on every plan within its collection and item limits (Free: 2 collections and 100 items a site); turning a folder into a Xodia collection needs a paid plan. Reference fields (up to 10 a collection) need their target collection to exist first.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

fields.description: Fields to add after the starter's (or after Title on blank)

collection.description: reference and multiReference: the target collection id

help.description: One line shown under the input

id.description: Optional: the key in items and code (camelCase); default from the label

label.description: The field's name as the owner sees it

options.description: option fields: [{"id": "news", "label": "News"}]; items store the id

position.description: Index to insert at; default the end

type.description: One of plainText, richText, image, multiImage, videoLink, link, email, phone, number, date, dateTime, switch, color, option, file, reference, multiReference

validation.description: minLength, maxLength, min, max, pattern, fileTypes

from.description: "blank" (a Title field only; add yours in fields) or a starter with its fields and sample items: blog (Blog posts), projects (Projects), team (Team), products (Products), events (Events), jobs (Jobs), testimonials (Testimonials), faq (FAQ)

id.description: Optional id (the folder name); default from the name

page.description: Collection page settings (same as update_collection page)

samples.description: Starters: write their sample items (default true). Use false when you add your own items next

urlFolder.description: Optional: item pages are /<urlFolder>/<slug>; one or more folder levels ("blog", "resources/blog"); default from the starter or the id

name: create_collection
title: Create a CMS collection
